rules.decision: Distribute original allocation penny remainders by largest fractional remainder; ties use stable registration ID order
invariants: Use original frozen amounts and eligible orders, never client amounts
Allocated components conserve the original line total exactly
Reordering query results cannot change allocation
Refunding one order never recalculates another order

rules.decision: Current reversal equals cumulative target for this original component minus already reversed amount; full refund clears remaining original component pennies
invariants: Only original verified successful refunds enter the cumulative basis
Keep the original component precision and calculation version
Duplicate and reordered callbacks cannot duplicate adjustment or debt
Refund SUCCESS CAS, adjustment, economic effect and receipt remain atomic

rules.decision: Charge the fixed fulfillment fee once per actually verified seat; negative organizer margin enters durable manual handling without automatic balance or deposit debit
invariants: Unverified seats accrue no fee
Replaying the same seat fact accrues no additional fee
Use the original frozen fee and recipient, not current mutable settings
Manual handling retains original order, close identity, amounts and reason
Do not clamp negative margin to zero or report successful settlement

rules.decision: ASR and the same subsequent NPC conversation share the existing quota: reserve before ASR, release only proven NOT_SENT, retain UNKNOWN, no second debit on text handoff; shop gen pool unchanged
invariants: Original actor, node/shop, request ID and audio fingerprint remain bound
Reservation must commit before external dispatch
An exception or transient NOT_FOUND does not prove NOT_SENT
Duplicate, restart and lost ACK do not create another reservation or model call
Handoff consumes or transfers the original reservation exactly once
Existing text-admission tombstone and deletion fences remain effective

rules.decision: When the original voice creation result cannot be confirmed, allow a separate request only after explicit confirmation that duplicate charges may occur; retain the original record and never automatically resend
invariants: The new request has a distinct stable identity
Keep original UNKNOWN, provider identity and reservation available for authorized recovery
Refresh, reentry and repeated confirmation do not automatically dispatch again
Late original results update only the original intent and do not replace a newer selection
Pending payload and recovery records remain isolated by account
